description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would become Forsworn.

A Trial that would have made you Forsworn finds nothing to break, this time.

You don't. The Trial event still happens and your Trial stage still rises if it would; the Forsworn status simply doesn't take hold, this time. What broke the Oath is not undone.

cinderfall.incomplete: 'Forsworn' and 'Trial stage' are homebrew statuses with zero rule-element or actor-field footprint anywhere across this class's cards -- neither appears in any system.rules array, so there is nothing for this feat to hook to suppress. This pass's own feats/general+feats/archetype sweep already confirmed no death-sequence-override rule element exists for the structurally similar 'prevent a triggered bad outcome from actually landing' shape (Defy the Reaper, Backup Self).
